reason: This passage describes the aftermath of the Golden Calf incident (Exodus 32). Moses reports Yahweh's command to the Levites to execute those who engaged in improper worship. The text explicitly states 'Thus says the Lord, God of Israel' followed by the command to kill 'each one his brother, his friend, his neighbor.' The passage records that three thousand men fell that day as a direct consequence of this idolatry. The deaths are presented as divine punishment enacted through the Levites for the people's failure to worship Yahweh properly (having instead worshipped the golden calf).
